scores.why: Ten sheets satisfy the limit, but sheet 09 has roughly 766 visible words and sheet 10 repeats substantial protocol detail already available in its ledger.

fixes.quote: #ch09 .brief
fixes.change: Keep the proposition, A/B choice and blocking decisions visible; move the full insight, supporting sections and readiness checklist into expandable reference material.

fixes.quote: #ch10 .decisions .sub-list
fixes.change: Replace the long protocol paragraph with a compact list of release thresholds; retain measurement procedures and qualifications in the existing ledger.

fixes.quote: #ch01 .takeaways
fixes.change: Remove this repeated summary: the title, opening paragraph and four evidence tiles already communicate these points.

scores.why: The required facts, deliverables, usage breakdowns and decision owners are present, but the most consequential observed failure deserves clearer presentation.

fixes.quote: Second fixture: 15/17, then 16/17 after a re-roll; exam-green is not lead-ready.
fixes.change: Name the material failures: the second fixture dropped a primary objective and asserted a superseded launch date despite passing the conflict check; connect these to the need for human review.

fixes.quote: Two of the ten questions, as the account lead would send them
fixes.change: Promote one actual client-facing question from this collapsed section into the presentation layer so stakeholders see the question deliverable alongside the bilingual extracts.

scores.why: The AI/code/people distinction is strong, but technical phrasing and ledger jargon still interrupt otherwise plain explanations.

fixes.quote: One master record holds 25 cited entries, 3 conflicts and 10 questions; both documents come from it, with Greek reviewed by a person.
fixes.change: Shorten to 'One source record produces both briefs; people review the language and resolve the questions,' leaving the counts in supporting evidence.

fixes.quote: Nine model-agent attempts, each potentially containing multiple turns (four documents, one retried).
fixes.change: Use 'Nine AI tasks and attempts, including one retry; each may involve several exchanges with the model.'

fixes.quote: What the machine wrote, with its receipt — the repair record and the second reader are in the extraction ledger
fixes.change: Use 'An extracted fact and its source'; put the ledger pointer beside the disclosure control.

scores.why: The answer-first opening and evidence-to-decision sequence work well, but repeated conflict previews and a late return to the budget weaken momentum.

fixes.quote: #ch03 .hero.clips
fixes.change: Summarize the four input documents here and retain only the readiness example; reserve the full audience and launch quotations for sheet 05.

fixes.quote: The budget stays «κάπου στα ογδόντα»: no invented or resolved total in the brief or either render. Shadow Draft A invented one; the creative lead strikes it.
fixes.change: Remove this closing detour because sheets 05, 07 and 09 already establish it; finish on the pilot authorization and its owners.

scores.why: Brief Builder has a clear promise, anatomy, outputs and human gates, although its operating handover and product principles are buried beneath implementation detail.

fixes.quote: Ask, don’t guess · Surface, don’t resolve · Flag, don’t correct · Look up, don’t invent · Sign, don’t send
fixes.change: Move this concise principles line out of the ledger and place it directly beneath the pipeline.

fixes.quote: Two brief champions, trained by week 4, run the command from a one-page runbook thereafter.
fixes.change: Promote this handover detail into a visible operator-to-champions line so the product clearly survives its author's departure.

scores.why: Source inspection shows a coherent editorial system and disciplined colour use, but oversized supporting copy and fragmented creative placement weaken hierarchy.

fixes.quote: .plate.pack
fixes.change: Compose the can alongside the square and vertical artwork in one deliberate desktop arrangement instead of placing a 40%-width asset on a separate row.

fixes.quote: .signrec
fixes.change: Separate the signer/date into a compact signature record and move the long edits narrative into the ledger.

fixes.quote: .legend li
fixes.change: Reduce the three 24px legend rows to a compact horizontal desktop legend, retaining a stacked phone treatment.

scores.why: The headline totals, models, timings, checks and sign-off match the artifacts, but one artwork description is stale and one blanket provenance claim overstates the evidence.

fixes.quote: Clear space of one wordmark height kept free on every side of the name; ring, leaf and name sit in the central column so the 9:16 crop clips nothing
fixes.change: Replace 'ring, leaf' with the actual wind stroke and bubbles, and qualify the clear-space assertion until the can application also satisfies it.

fixes.quote: Proposition, insight, tone and reasons to believe are the model’s; every fact cites a brief entry.
fixes.change: Say that factual claims carry references but still require verification, consistent with the explicitly identified unsupported origin claim.

scores.why: Navigation, focus handling, local links and dependency-free packaging are thoughtfully implemented, but the phone CSS can squeeze Contents and places essential creative corrections after the entire body.

fixes.quote: .ruler .fol
fixes.change: Keep Contents outside the horizontally scrolling tick strip, or hide the ticks on phones; its current shrinkable width competes with ten minimum-width tick buttons.

fixes.quote: .margin { order: 2; }
fixes.change: Keep the three-corrections warning before the creative draft on phones instead of moving it below the long article.

fixes.quote: .resolve
fixes.change: Stack the label, resolution and initials at narrow widths so the long decision text receives the full content width.

scores.why: The wind-and-fizz concept, palette, mock-up labels and cited specs are credible, but the can crowds mandatory wordmark clear space and the vertical execution remains an acknowledged unfinished crop.

fixes.quote: .plate.pack img
fixes.change: Increase the space above and below 'Meltemi Fizz' to at least one wordmark height; the embedded can image leaves noticeably smaller gaps to the symbol and descriptor.

fixes.quote: 9:16 still frame at the TikTok in-feed spec; the lockup sits in TikTok’s caption zone, a dedicated 9:16 layout would raise it
fixes.change: Create that dedicated vertical composition now, raising the lockup while preserving clear space and the explicit mock-up label.

overall: Strong evidence and product logic; not yet unchanged-shippable because the final sheets need tighter editing and stronger mobile hierarchy. Hash verified; no repository files changed. Chrome aborted both rendering attempts, so visual and UX assessments rely on HTML/CSS/JavaScript inspection and direct inspection of the embedded can image.
